sheets.animations.nothing_yet.note: Empty state of a list of animations.

sticker.export.note: Action on an animation: saves it as an animated sticker file (.tgs).

sticker.note.note: Message in the save panel of a sticker.
sticker.note.en: An animated sticker (.tgs): 512 × 512, 60 frames a second, vector only.
sticker.note.es: Un sticker animado (.tgs): 512 × 512, 60 fotogramas por segundo, solo vectores.
sticker.note.zh-Hans: 动画贴纸（.tgs）：512 × 512，每秒 60 帧，仅矢量。

sticker.note.faster.note: Added to the save panel message when the animation was sped up to fit 3 seconds.
sticker.note.faster.en: It plays {speed}× faster to fit 3 seconds.
sticker.note.faster.es: Se reproduce {speed}× más rápido para caber en 3 segundos.
sticker.note.faster.zh-Hans: 加快 {speed} 倍播放，以控制在 3 秒内。

sticker.note.trimmed.note: Added to the save panel message when the animation was cut at 3 seconds.

sticker.error.title.note: Title of the alert when a sticker cannot be made.
sticker.error.title.es: No se pudo crear el sticker

sticker.error.empty.note: Why a sticker cannot be made: the animation has no beats.

sticker.error.too_big.note: Why a sticker cannot be made: even simplified it is over the 64 KB limit.
sticker.error.too_big.en: It is still {kb} KB when simplified. A sticker may be 64 KB: try fewer beats or simpler moves.
sticker.error.too_big.es: Simplificado sigue ocupando {kb} KB. Un sticker puede ocupar 64 KB: prueba con menos pasos o movimientos más sencillos.
sticker.error.too_big.zh-Hans: 简化后仍有 {kb} KB。贴纸最多 64 KB：试试更少的节拍或更简单的动作。
